lts_divorced.definition: Describing a person whose marriage has ended legally.
lts_divorced.example: He is divorced, and the children spend the week with him.

mon_real.definition: True to fact; not a simulation.
mon_real.example: With prices rising, the real value of the 2 000 $ falls while the ticket still says 2 000 $.

set_menu.definition: A starter, a main course and a dessert sold together at a single price. Often the cheapest and most predictable choice.
set_menu.example: I will take the set menu, please.

sign_off.definition: The closing line of an email, such as "Kind regards", followed by your name.
sign_off.example: Use a plain sign-off: Kind regards, then your name and title.
